messages:
Maria (CS): FYI Halcyon Analytics wants to change renewal cadence from 12mo to 9mo and pay Net60 by PO. PO number they sent: HAL-PO-0926. The PO references a vendor code that doesn't match our billing entity. Need quick ops decision before we schedule Dedicated capacity.

Ben (AE): Their procurement team says Net60 is non-negotiable this cycle. They offered a signed PO but used their master vendor code (HALCY-GLOBAL) instead of the UK subsidiary we invoice. They asked if we can accept the PO as-is and route billing to the global entity.

Priya (Finance): We cannot invoice against a different legal entity without a signed entity swap or an invoice-to/ship-to mapping. Options: (A) obtain corrected PO with vendor code HALCY-UK, (B) accept a wire deposit equal to 30% of MRR as security, or (C) execute an entity assignment addendum. Each has accounting implications.

Jonah (Legal): Quick take: entity assignment addendum is fastest if both parties sign it today. Otherwise require PO that matches Redwood Limited (our UK billing entity). Also we need explicit reference to SOW and the payment terms in the PO. We'll draft an addendum template and share.

Sam (SE): From a provisioning standpoint, if Finance requires confirmation beyond 30 days, we should delay GPU pool allocation. We can spin up a sandbox preview and limited throughput for onboarding so customer can start integration without consuming reserved capacity.

Lily (Payments): Payments Ops: We can accept PO with HALCY-GLOBAL but it will route to collections and may need a billing entity swap later; that delays revenue recognition. If AE can provide contact for procurement approver and CC the signed PO to payments@redwood, I can triage.

Ben (AE): Looping in their procurement lead: emma.daly@halcyon.com. I asked Emma to re-issue PO with vendor_code=HALCY-UK or sign the entity addendum. She replied: "We can do an addendum; procurement needs a copy now."

onboarding-bot: Activation checklist created (Halcyon Analytics): steps: upload signed PO, validate vendor code, legal addendum signed, finance credit hold cleared, schedule provisioning. Link: https://console.redwood.example/onboard/HALCY-0926

Priya (Finance): To unblock faster, we can accept a 30% good-faith wire (applied to invoice) and mark the order as prepaid until full Net60 clears. That avoids entity swap but requires treasury confirmation. @Lily can you confirm wiring instructions availability?

Lily (Payments): We can provide wire routing. Sending templated instructions now. If they wire 30% our system can release a limited provisioning flag. We'll still need final PO for audit.

Maria (CS): I'll offer the customer two paths: 1) sign addendum today and we proceed with full provisioning, or 2) wire 30% and we open limited provisioning while final paperwork completes. I'll ask which they prefer.

Ben (AE): Customer prefers addendum route. Emma confirmed procurement will sign addendum after Legal sends it. Jonah can you share the template to emma.daly@halcyon.com and cc payments@redwood?

Jonah (Legal): Sending now. Draft addendum attached in email thread: "Entity Assignment & Payment Terms Addendum". It includes: reference to SOW HAL-2026-09, Net60 terms, late fees @ 1.5% p/month, and billing entity confirmation box.

Priya (Finance): Once signed addendum received and PO attached, I'll remove the credit hold and schedule invoice with Net60. Please ensure SOW reference matches exactly.

Ben (AE): Emma replied: "Addendum signed and attached" — forwarding to payments. Attached PO still lists HALCY-GLOBAL as vendor_code but the addendum confirms invoicing to HALCY-UK.

Lily (Payments): Received both docs. Uploading to billing portal and creating invoice HAL-2026-09 with Net60. Marking order as "limited provisioning allowed" per CS request.

Maria (CS): Thanks. Enabling limited provisioning and notifying PM to proceed with integration support only. Full Dedicated pool will wait until invoice posts.

onboarding-bot: Status update: PO & addendum attached; invoice HAL-2026-09 created (net60). Provisioning mode: limited.

Priya (Finance): Closing loop: credit hold released. Please confirm SOW number in tracker is HAL-2026-09 (exact).

Maria (CS): Confirmed. Tracker updated. I'll send the customer kickoff invite for integration work, noting capacity limits until invoice clears.

Lily (Payments): Setting calendar reminders for day 45 and day 55 for collections outreach. Closing this thread once full provisioning is authorized.
